## ✅ Type of Change

- [ ] 🚀 **Feature** — New capability (non-breaking)
- [ ] 🐛 **Bug fix** — Corrects unexpected behavior
- [ ] 📝 **Docs** — Documentation only changes
- [ ] ♻️ **Refactor** — Code change with no behavior change
- [ ] ⚡ **Performance** — Improves speed or efficiency
- [ ] 🔧 **Chore** — Tooling, dependencies, build process
- [ ] 💥 **Breaking change** — API or behavior change that may break consumers
